name: MomentumHero - Video Backdrop
description: The hero with the Hero video field set to a real committed file. READ THE CAPTURE CAREFULLY: it shows the hero PHOTO, not a frame of video, and that is correct rather than a failure. A video element displays its poster until playback starts, the poster here IS the hero image, and playback does not start in the headless capture browser (confirmed: a VP9 WebM behaves identically, so it is not a codec gap). So this frame is the poster path — the same pixels a visitor sees for the instant before the video starts, and the same pixels they keep if it never does. What it proves is the layout claim: the headline, subhead and Give button are exactly where they are without a video, because the hero gained a backdrop rather than becoming a player.
